spec_sources.name: Portable Network Graphics (PNG) Specification, Third Edition
spec_sources.used_for: PNG color types, bit-depth restrictions, PLTE/tRNS rules, filter method 0, IDAT image data, and APNG fdAT frame-data inheritance.

notes: This lab validates deterministic 8-bit non-interlaced APNG frame color types only.
It covers color types 0, 2, 3, 4, and 6 with full-canvas source frames.
It does not claim full APNG/PNG conformance, live editor preservation, or final production carrier selection.
